title: Making SRD_MenuBackgrounds, YEP_X_EquipCustomize and YEP_QuestJournal work together.

posts.author: Gammatoad
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
I'm trying to get three plugins to work together, and I'm not sure if it's even possible.
I use Equip Customize to have a little system where you upgrade and attach augments to your gear.
And I also use Menu Backgrounds to have my own pictures in the background of each menu.
However, when I go into the Equip Customize menu it's just bare because, naturally, there's no option for it in the settings for Menu Backgrounds.
Menu Backgrounds has a bunch of Custom slots to be used. Is it possible to connect  these slots to the Equip Customize menu? Is it possible to do the same for the Quest Journal?
These two menus now look a bit subpar when compared to the ones I can use Menu Backgrounds with.
It would be cool if they could all look similar.

posts.author: oooNUKEooo
posts.body: well... since youre using SRDs plugins, there are plugins that deal with windows skins. one that you can set a different window skin to any window your game uses - provided you know that window name; the plugin helps you to locate some - theres also one that helps with image stretching on windows and so on... you can even use the hud maker package to modify menus sizes and other details - including provided by other plugins.

posts.author: Gammatoad
posts.body:
Yes, I had a look at other SRD plugins, but I don't think I need that much customization (such as what is offered by HUD Maker). I just need to be able to place pictures on the background for those two menus (EquipCustomize and Quest Journal). Here's an example of what I'm talking about:
In the screenshots you can see the main menu (with a background picture that involves a little dragon and a quote) while the EquipCustomize menu is still the same boring old transparent RPG Maker default menu. Is there a way to tell the MenuBackgrounds plugin to place a picture behind the weapon customize menu the same way I did for the others?

posts.author: oooNUKEooo
posts.body:
well...
as really desperate workaround, i would call a picture on screen before opening the menu (a yanfly plugin does this; events before and after main menu, if im not mistaken), then make all windows transparent with SRD HUD and menu plugin, then remove the picture when menu is done.
thats what id do if i would go about doing that on every add'ed-by-plugins window without going thru lines of code.

posts.author: Gammatoad
posts.body:
Ah, that seems like it would cause more problems than solve.
Perhaps I'll give HUD Maker a try.
Thank you for your help.
